interruption.description: 60% link; at 30% the connection is cut for 10 s (all sockets closed, new ones refused)

network_switch.description: Wi-Fi-like 100% link; at 40% all connections drop for 3 s and the link comes back as a cellular-like 20% link (approximation: the client IP does not change)

resets.description: 60% link; at 25%, 50%, 75% every connection is reset (TCP RST) for 2 s

timeouts.description: 60% link; at 30% and 60% data is silently dropped for 30 s (hung connection, longer than the client's 20 s stall timeout)

client_restart.description: 60% link; at 40% the client process is killed (SIGKILL) and restarted 2 s later

server_restart.description: 60% link; at 40% the server process is killed (SIGKILL) and restarted 3 s later
